description.value: Middle Beach Lodge is a secluded oceanfront resort set on 40 acres of rugged West Coast headland, featuring two lodges, twenty self-contained cabins, and treetop treehouse accommodations overlooking the Pacific. The property includes nearly a mile of private beach, hand-cut forest trails for quiet nature immersion, and kayaking excursions — all roughly 3 km from the village of Tofino. The on-site Headlands Lounge serves lunch and dinner, making it a self-contained wilderness retreat with direct access to the Pacific Rim National Park Reserve area.
